card.name: Partway through odd or respelled words
card.fires_on: Pieces in the middle or end of a long, unusual, or oddly spelled word. Typical cases are dictionary pronunciation guides, garbled OCR text, and brand names split into pieces.

modes.label: Pronunciation respellings
modes.description: Syllables inside hyphenated pronunciation guides in dictionary entries.

modes.label: Split names and garbled text
modes.description: Pieces of a long proper name, brand name, or OCR-garbled word.

card.writes: No clear link between the promoted and suppressed tokens, which are a mix of Chinese pieces and rare fragments.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of strange or broken-up words, such as pronunciation guides and misspelled brand names.
